Second, the app serves as a channel for public participation, facilitating citizens to report pollution and polluters and giving consumers the data they need to implement green consumption.

The app’s innovative features include the following:
1)	Authoritative and comprehensive environmental data and dynamic maps:
	a. Air quality & forecasts
	Data on six air quality indicators from over 2000 air quality monitoring stations in China and over 5000 additional monitoring stations in Asia, Europe, the U.S. and worldwide
	Air quality rankings, and statistics by the hour, day, month and year for air pollution and smog monitoring
Dynamic air quality data visualization maps, including past three-day air quality trends for China and global monitoring data
	Warnings for heavy smog alerts in China to help users keep an eye on when stretches of heavy smog might hit
	b. Water quality
        Data from over 8000 surface water quality monitoring stations across China
	c. Pollution source emissions
	Real-time emissions data for over 9000 key air emissions and wastewater pollution sources, including detailed daily average value analysis
	d. Weather & forecasts
        Authoritative worldwide real-time weather data and forecasts from meteorological authorities; detailed weather forecasts all the way down to the district and county level in China
2)	Interactive channels for improving environmental quality and green consumption:
	a. “Micro-reporting” mechanism to expose polluters
	If you notice factory emissions are out of compliance, then you can share them to Weibo or your WeChat moments, and tag in the official Weibo accounts of local environmental protection authorities to bring issues to their attention
“Foul & filthy” rivers module
	Polluted urban waters can be reported directly to the platform of official authorities via the Blue Map app
	b. “Green choice” consumer action platform
        Environmental performance rankings for popular brands and hot products. “Like” or “dislike” your favorite brands and laggard brands, and then share your findings with your friends on WeChat and Weibo to help others consume green, too!
        c. Interactive sharing wall
	Sharing wall to post pictures of blue sky days, pollution, smog and other related issues to encourage environmental improvement and expose pollution!

Protect your family and your children, protect our blue skies and clear waters – the Blue Map 4.0 awaits!

[Awards & Achievements]
IPE and the Blue Map have received countless awards in China for environmental protection and innovation. In addition, IPE founding director Ma Jun was awarded as China’s “Green Person of the Year” and was named as one of TIME Magazine’s World’s 100 Most Influential People in 2006. He was also honored with the Magsaysay Award in 2009 and Goldman Prize in 2012 for his environmental protection work in China, as well as the 2015 Skoll Foundation Award for Social Entrepreneurship for his innovative approach to “lifting the veil” on China’s pollution problems.
